entities.summary: Anbar Awakening, a transformative movement in Iraq (2006–2011). Emerged from US-led coalition invades Iraq; Saddam's regime falls within weeks and Bombing of the al-Askari Shrine triggers full-scale sectarian civil war. Catalyzed Sectarian Civil War and US Surge and Iraqi forces liberate Mosul after nine months of brutal urban warfare.
